title: Plasma Connect +
tagline: An incentive tool to encourage people to donate blood/plasma for people in need.
description:
Project aimed at to grow and encourage donor community especially the ones who are recovered from COVID19.
The current pandemic has made life a chaos and Plasma therapy has shown good result in recovery rates in young and older people.
But finding a compatible donor isn't as simple.
Hence a local community driven dao, which can conduct these drives preserving the privacy can help save lives.
how_its_made:
It is made using web3 solution:

Aragon for the creating the Dao,

Eth.build for better visualization of concept,

Magic sdk for ETH wallet/util,

IPFS for creating the storage.

Smart contract for pinning the storage with wallet.

Complete client sided react dapp

hosted on firebase hosting.
